response.sql: WITH matched_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS overall_avg_rebate FROM matched_fees), grouped AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS average_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS average_relative_gap FROM matched_fees GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune AS order_type, g.average_rebate, g.average_relative_gap, g.average_rebate - o.overall_avg_rebate AS above_overall_average FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.average_rebate > o.overall_avg_rebate ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10;
